errors.text: The hypothesis ambiguously presents FEP as directly calculating the solid-liquid free-energy difference. The intended efficient perturbation is a DFT-MTP free-energy correction with strong phase-space overlap; direct perturbation between structurally distinct solid and liquid ensembles would generally fail from poor overlap.
The predicted 100-1000-fold speedup and less than 1% cost target are unsupported by the cited evidence and substantially overstate the target result.
